— 🇾🇪/🇸🇦 WATCH: Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree announced four major operations over the past 24 hours involving ballistic and cruise missiles and drones against targets across Saudi Arabia.
Saree said King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was targeted in three phases, while separate strikes hit Aramco’s Shugadam gas facility, the Tanajib oil facility in the Eastern Province and King Fahd International Airport in Dammam. He also claimed six ballistic missiles and two drones struck Saudi troop concentrations around Ras al-Ara and Al-Saqiya.
The Houthis said their operations inside Saudi Arabia will continue to escalate and renewed warnings to international airlines against using Saudi airports, excluding those serving Mecca and Medina.

Official statement from the UAE Attorney General on the Flydubai case.
The Omani first officer planned to carry out a suicide attack by crashing a Flydubai passenger plane into the terminal at Ben Gurion Airport. The stated objective was to cause as many casualties as possible, in a manner similar to the September 11 attacks.
The roots of his radicalization go back to 2017, when he stayed in Melbourne, Australia, for studies and began adopting extremist views.
He also gathered intelligence in preparation for the attack attempt. That collection took place on two flights to Israel and covered both the flight path and Ben Gurion Airport itself.
On the hiring question, the Attorney General's statement says the suspect met all professional and security requirements of Flydubai at the time he was taken on. The preliminary checks conducted on him revealed no signs of extremist positions or terrorist intentions.

🇾🇪🇸🇦Houthis claim three strikes on Riyadh airport
Yemen's Ansar Allah says it attacked King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh three times since Friday, disrupting air traffic and forcing the airport to shut down completely.
Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said the group carried out four military operations over the past 24 hours, using ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and drones.
The strikes were conducted in three stages, according to Saree, who announced the operations on Al Masirah television.
